notes: No free timestamped historical lines exist, so the combined model is validated only at the final horizon. Early releases apply it to the line observed at release time and are labelled accordingly; early-horizon accuracy is measured prospectively.
Contributions explain the fitted model's adjustment to the market line; they are not causal claims.
Probabilities: P(home/away/tie). Intervals: 80%/95% ranges from out-of-fold residuals.
Non-QB injuries are not inputs of the frozen models. A separate trial line (football_only_inj, display and tracking only) adds them to the stats-only model. Weather and coaching are not modelled.
